tools.name: search_legislation
tools.description: Search Lebanese legislation (laws, decrees, decisions), their articles, court rulings, or Official Gazette issues, by keyword. Arabic and French. Returns verbatim snippets from the Lebanese University's database, never an AI-written summary. Not legal advice.

tools.name: get_law
tools.description: Get a law, decree or similar text's metadata (kind, number, date, status), its table of contents (article numbers) and the texts it amended or was amended by. Use get_article to read one article's verbatim text. Not legal advice.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get one article's verbatim Arabic text as in force today (and French, when the Centre published it and no amendment has replaced it), its in-force status, amendment history, and the canonical and source URLs. When an amendment replaced the wording, text_ar is the new wording and centre_text_ar the e

tools.name: get_ruling
tools.description: Get one court ruling (judgment) by id: court, number, date, panel, and its verbatim text when the Centre holds it as typed text (some rulings exist only as a scanned file). Not legal advice.

tools.name: get_gazette_issue
tools.description: Get one Official Gazette issue by id: its number, publication date, and the laws, decrees and decisions it published. Not legal advice.

tools.name: get_links
tools.description: Get the graph edges into or out of one item: a law, an article, a ruling, an opinion, a research study or a Gazette issue. Use this to walk citations and amendments directly, instead of only what get_law and get_article attach automatically. Not legal advice.

tools.name: possibly_affected
tools.description: Get the general repeals that may touch a law: earlier texts with a "all provisions contrary to this law are repealed" clause pointing at it. A list to check, never a finding that anything was actually repealed. Not legal advice.

labels.name: list_legislation
labels.description: List laws, decrees and decisions by date, newest first: for "everything published since January 2025" call with since "2025-01". The date is the publication date: the Official Gazette date, else the issue date (each entry's date, with gazette_number, gazette_date and gazette_issue_id). Recent texts

labels.name: list_gazette_issues

labels.name: possibly_affected
labels.description: Get the general repeals that may touch a law: earlier texts with a "all provisions contrary to this law are repealed" clause pointing at it. A list to check, never a finding that anything was actually repealed. Not legal advice.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search_legislation" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
